name: GSK plc
tagline: We unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together for health impact, shareholder returns and thriving people
hero_kpi_rationale: La R&D est le principal moteur de création de valeur dans le secteur biopharma. GSK y consacre 18% de son chiffre d'affaires (6,4 milliards £), avec une forte intégration des technologies avancées comme l'IA à chaque étape du processus de découverte et développement.

kpis.description: Oncologie + HIV + immunologie. Croissance principale. Trelegy, Dovato.
Shingrix (zona), Bexsero, Arexvy (RSV). RSV en accélération.
Marge op ajustée. Discipline coûts + mix HIV/oncologie.
Provision litige Zantac (ranitidine, cancer). Accord global octobre 2024.

company_description: GSK plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, and manufacture of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines to prevent and treat disease in the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Commercial Operations and Total R&D segments. The company offers specialty medicines that include oncology, respiratory/immunology, inflammation, and inhaled medicines for HIV, respiratory eosinophildriven diseases, lupus and lupus nephritis, ovarian cancer, and endometrial cancer. It also provides vaccines for Shingles, Meningitis, RSV, Seasonal Influenza, Hepatitis, Diphtheria, Tetanus, Acellular Pertussis, Rotavirus, Pertussis, Polio, Haemophilus, Invasive Diseases, Pneumonia, Acute Otitis Media, Measles, Mumps, Rubella and Chickenpox, and Human Papilloma Virus. Additionally, the company offers general medicines for asthma, COPD, bacterial infection, benign prostatic hyperplasia, allergic rhinitis, and inflammatory skin conditions.
